parsed.rationale: All four records are production code with no restraint markers, but the cluster signal here is 'name-collisions' rather than duplication of logic. The canonical type and its core extension live in 'Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/PlaybackReason.swift' (package: Playback), while the remaining two records are deliberately scoped extensions — 'PlaybackReason+PlayerHeaderView.swift' in package PlayerHeaderView and 'PlaybackReason+App.swift' in package app:iOS. This is the standard Swift pattern of extending a core type with UI- or app-layer-specific behaviour in the consuming module; the name collision is structural coincidence arising from the extension-naming convention, not a duplication problem. No fields or signatures are shared (fields_or_signature is empty on all members), so there is no concrete member to consolidate.
